verses.2: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.5: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.7: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.
verses.8: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.9: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.10: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
